title: Script host-process GraphQL startup for eval
description:
Document and script starting the local GraphQL process (one uvicorn worker, data dir, API key). No Compose, no Postgres. Behavior is the host-process story under this epic.

Plexus implementation: plx-765ff0 / plx-6d41d0. Virtuus changes are not expected.
